name: Catalog Footage
description: Catalogs the raw footage files into a structured clip catalog.

inputs.name: project_config
inputs.description: State input: project_config - the project's own declarations. `audio.program_stream` (or `source.program_stream`) declares which audio stream is the program mix; `audio.measure_program_stream` (or `source.measure_program_stream`) opts into measuring it off the footage when nothing is declared.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: State input: project_folder - read for the project's own `source:` block in project.yaml when the broadcast project_config carries no program-stream declaration.

inputs.name: program_stream
inputs.description: Direct input: the 1-based program-mix channel ordinal, overriding any declaration. Absent in ordinary runs.

inputs.name: measure_program_stream
inputs.description: Direct input: measure the program mix off the footage, overriding any declaration. Absent in ordinary runs.

outputs.name: project_fps
outputs.description: Modal frame rate of the source footage - the pipeline's timebase.

outputs.name: source_resolution
outputs.description: Modal SOURCE resolution. Describes the footage; NOT the render target. The delivery format comes from library/tools/delivery_format.py.
